name: Disk Pulse
author: Fred Nix
description: A living storage die: free space, read and write throughput, drive busy time, I/O pressure, drive temperature and SMART health, btrfs allocation, seven-day history, and focus-only disk hogs.

barWidget.description: Animated free space, read/write throughput, drive temperature and persistent seven-day history. Right-click to choose a readout.
